title: Design System: Marwan El Saabi - Portfolio

headline.purpose: Two-tone section headlines: subject in ink, result in gray.

label.purpose: Nav links, language switch, footer. Never uppercase.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Blue pill for the main action of a section.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 980px; background: #0066cc; color: #fff; font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #004f9e; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined pill for secondary actions; fills blue on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 980px; background: transparent; color: #0066cc; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #0066cc; font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #0066cc; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chevron Link
components.description: Blue text link with a drawn chevron that nudges right on hover.
components.html: Try the live app
components.css: .ds-chev { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #0066cc; font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-chev svg { transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chev:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chev:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Screenshot Window
components.description: A real app screenshot in a white frame with the window shadow.
components.css: .ds-window { width: 320px; background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 32px 64px -24px rgba(29,29,31,.28), 0 12px 24px -12px rgba(29,29,31,.14); } .ds-window-img { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: #f5f5f7; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Sticky 52px translucent bar: name, links, language switch, small CV pill.
components.html: Marwan El SaabiWorkAboutToolkitDownload CV
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.78); backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(20px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06); font-family: 'Geist', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1d1f; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 30px; } .ds-nav-links a { font-size: 13px; color: #1d1d1f; opacity: .8; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-cv { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 980px; background: #0066cc; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is presented the way a product launch page presents a product: one idea per section, a headline that states the result, and the real thing shown big. Here the "products" are the projects, and the imagery is always a real screenshot of the live app or a real figure from the project's repo. The layout is generous, light and quiet so the work carries the page.

This replaced an earlier editorial "lab notebook" look (warm paper, serif type, terracotta accent, "Fig. NN" captions). None of that vocabulary carries over.
keyCharacteristics: White and light-gray sections alternating; one blue for links and buttons, nothing else colored.
One sans family (Geist) for everything, large and tightly tracked for headlines.
Two-tone headlines: the subject in ink, the claim in gray, inside the same sentence.
Real screenshots framed as soft-shadowed windows; no illustrations, no fake UI.
Projects get different compositions by importance: full-width feature, split feature, then a bento of the rest.

rules.name: The Blue Means Click Rule
rules.body: Blue appears only on interactive elements. Never use it for emphasis, decoration or headings.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Headline Rule
rules.body: A section headline names the thing in ink and states the result in gray, in one sentence ending with a period: "Retail demand forecasting. 4.8% better than the strongest baseline." No eyebrow label above it.

rules.name: The No-Em-Dash Rule
rules.body: No em dash or en-dash separator in visible text. Ranges use a plain hyphen (2025-2027).

rules.name: The Only Windows Float Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to screenshot windows. Do not add shadows to tiles, buttons or text blocks.

dos: Do state each project's real, verifiable result in its headline.
Do use real screenshots or real repo figures for every image, framed as windows or tile media.
Do keep blue for clickable things only (The Blue Means Click Rule).
Do give a new project a composition that fits its importance instead of copying an existing section.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow or label above a headline; the two-tone headline carries it.
Don't use an em dash or en-dash separator in visible text.
Don't add a second accent color, gradients or gradient text.
Don't add shadows outside screenshot windows.
Don't use monospace for decoration; tabular figures handle numbers.
Don't fill an empty spot with a placeholder or a drawn fake interface; leave it out until there is a real image.
